summary: Iteration 28: verified two new features on top of OFFLINE payment mode — (1) /master → /master/dashboard redirect and (2) full-screen Vendor Kiosk at /vendor/kiosk. Backend regression (test_offline_payment_mode.py) 24/24 PASS after a small fix to the test file to load backend/.env so pymongo hits the same DB the API uses. Frontend: 6/6 kiosk-related flows PASS end-to-end (redirect + no route warning, role-gating, enter-kiosk link, kiosk shell + tally + connection + navbar-absent, manual-entry → confirm → backend 404 → error-phase → retry, exit modal wrong-then-right password → /vendor/orders). Throw-away QA vendor was seeded via a helper script and scrubbed on teardown. No new bugs.

critical_code_review_comments: Kiosk.js confirmExit() re-uses POST /api/auth/login as a password-verification primitive. Functionally correct, but it (a) issues brand new access/refresh cookies (fine, same user), (b) is subject to brute-force lockout at 5 tries — a fat-fingered manager will get the vendor locked out for 15 minutes; consider a dedicated /auth/verify-password endpoint or exempt this call from brute-force counters.

Kiosk.js fetchTally() derives today's totals client-side from GET /api/orders + payment_method filter. It filters by paid_at >= startOfDay, but does NOT filter by vendor — for a vendor user this is fine because the API already scopes /orders to their vendor_id, but this coupling is implicit; a comment or a dedicated /api/vendor/kiosk/tally endpoint would be more robust and cheaper on large stores.

Kiosk.js: success screen auto-closes in 3s (setTimeout), but if the vendor clicks kiosk-scan-now-btn during that window, backToScan() clears the timer via clearTimeout(successTimerRef.current) — good. However pressing the browser back button or opening the exit modal during the 3s window does NOT clear the timer; the state will race with unmount. Low-severity edge case.

App.js line 215 <Route path="/master" element={<Navigate to="/master/dashboard" replace />} /> — correct and the console 'No routes matched' warning is gone. If more /master/* aliases exist unlinked, consider `path="/master" element={<Navigate .../>}` under a wildcard, but current shape is fine.

Kiosk.js: no ProtectedRoute-level check that camera permission failed — the useEffect that starts Html5Qrcode falls back to manualMode with an error toast. Acceptable, but on iPad Safari camera-permission denials can leave scannerRef in a partially-initialized state; the stopScanner() call is guarded so should not throw.

rca of the issue: No production issue found. Only a test-tooling bug was fixed: previous iteration's pytest silently skipped 9 tests because pymongo defaulted DB_NAME='test_database' (backend/.env sets DB_NAME='cravitoo_db'). Fix: load backend/.env from the test file so MONGO_URL/DB_NAME match the running API. Now all 24 tests execute and pass.
